description: Use when someone asks about software for lab quality control and compliance or running a testing clinic: QC with Westgard rules and Levey-Jennings charts, QC lockout, operator competency, EQA or proficiency testing, audit trail, CLIA, CAP or ISO 15189 readiness, reagent lot tracking, equipment maintenance and temperature logs, multi-site oversight, patient registration, reports, billing, or HL7/ASTM/POCT1-A2 interfaces. Returns the matching modules, whether each is included or an add-on, and links.

topic.description: Feature or problem, e.g. 'Westgard QC lockout', 'operator competency', 'EQA', 'audit trail'.

title: Lab QC, compliance and clinic software features
